rejected.description: In this free exhibition in Vienna, artist Njola reflects on the devastating collapse of the Kiteezi landfill in Kampala on 10 August 2024, which claimed lives and left many people homeless. Using discarded plastic bags, car tyres and old clothes, she transforms waste from her local area into wearable art, paintings and sculptures. Much of this rubbish originally came from the Global North, raising an important question about our constant consumption and where our waste ultimately ends up. Her fashion collection is inspired by Kampala’s Boda-Boda motorcycle taxi riders, while the oversized Boda-Boda installation sends a clear message: rubbish is a resource.
